components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Disclosure list. Each row is a <details>/<summary> with a Lumen-chrome chevron at the END (per AGENTS.md hard rule 14 — native disclosure marker is suppressed via .lumen-summary). Two modes — single (only one row open at a time, accordion-style) and multiple (rows open independently, disclosure-list-style).

components.name: ActionSheet
components.summary: Mobile-only choice sheet. Bottom-anchored list of 2-6 large-tap actions with one optional destructive action and a mandatory Cancel button. Apple HIG / iOS-flavor. Distinct from DropdownMenu (desktop, item granularity), Sheet (free-form content), and Dialog (centered decision).

components.name: AIBadge
components.summary: Inline 'AI generated' / 'AI summary' / 'AI confidence' label. Three flavors — badge (small chip), confidence (with 0-100 score), thinking (with the AI-shimmer + a typing indicator). Mandatory next to any text or value derived from AI inference, so users can tell what's machine-authored.

components.name: AIPromptInput
components.summary: AI prompt composer. Auto-grows multiline textarea + leading model selector + trailing send button (the lone primary on the surface) + optional attachment + slash-command picker + token counter. Distinct from a plain Textarea — it carries the AI-shimmer treatment, sparkles-leading send icon, and a contract that the consumer wires to streaming responses.

components.name: AISuggestion
components.summary: Inline AI proposal card. Left-edge accent stroke + Sparkles glyph + suggestion body + accept/reject IconButtons. Used inside RTE inline suggestions, AI-rewrite cards, AI-summary previews. Distinct from CitationCard (the source) and AIBadge (the inline 'AI generated' label).

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline, in-flow status block. Persistent (not dismissed automatically), tied to a region of the page (not the whole app), and never floating. Four tones — info, success, warning, danger. Optional dismiss control + optional inline action. Distinct from Toast (transient, page-level, floating), Banner (page-level non-dismissible system state), and ValidationMessage (single-field form error).

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: User / actor identity image with deterministic name-hashed fallback colors and initials when no image is present. Five sizes (xs / sm / md / lg / xl). Square, rounded, or circle. AvatarGroup composes up to N visible avatars with a '+N more' overflow chip — pair with PresenceIndicator (a colored dot at the corner) for live state.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A small pill that labels status, category, or count. Always paired with a label or shape.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: Page-level system state strip. Stretches edge-to-edge, sticks above the page header, communicates state that affects the entire app — maintenance windows, outages, trial countdowns, account suspension, environment indicators (sandbox / test mode). Distinct from Alert (region-scoped) and Toast (transient).

components.name: BottomNav
components.summary: Mobile-only primary navigation rail anchored to the bottom of the viewport. 3-5 destinations, icon-on-top + tiny label, active state painted with text.accent + a top-edge brand stroke. Distinct from TabBar (in-page tabs) and from Sidebar (desktop).

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: Where am I, how did I get here, and how do I step back. A horizontal trail of links separated by ChevronRight, with the current page as the terminal non-link node. Truncates with an ellipsis menu when the trail exceeds the available width.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Primary action affordance. Renders a labeled, focusable, intent-bearing control. Five sizes × eight intents × three shapes. The single most important interaction component in Lumen. v0.12.2 dialed the primary-hover glow ladder down: rest unchanged at the brand-defining 0 0 16px lime-a25, hover trims to 0 0 20px lime-a28 plus quieter mid/outer halo layers (see ADR 0022).

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: A row of joined buttons that share a single rounded outline. For segmented filters, toolbar action groups, and density toggles.

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: Standalone calendar surface. Three view modes — month (the canonical grid), week (7-column day-rows), agenda (event-grouped list). Distinct from DatePicker (single-value input + popover calendar) — this is the full-screen / detail-card calendar primitive used for scheduling, availability, and resource views. Localized via date-fns / Intl. Honors the system week start.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A bounded surface with a hairline border and optional subtle shadow. v0.12.1 introduced the corner-clip contract — padding='none' auto-clips edge-touching children to the rounded shape. v0.12.4 closed the trade-off the corner-clip introduced for descendant focus rings: the global :focus-visible rule now pairs outline 2px solid lime-a64 + offset 1px (structurally immune to ancestor overflow:hidden) with the existing soft box-shadow halo, so focus rings on Pagination buttons and other interactive descendants inside <Card padding='none'> stay visible. The v0.12.4 Combobox portal migration also means a hand-rolled Combobox dropdown inside <Card padding='none'> now escapes the clip exactly like Radix-portaled chrome already did.

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: Horizontally paginated content scroller. Renders a slide track with snap-points; auto-advance is OFF by default (auto-advance is a WCAG 2.2.2 hazard unless explicitly opt-in with controls). Includes prev/next IconButtons, dot indicators, and optional progress. Distinct from Tabs (sibling views) and ProductGallery (image-zoom flavor).

components.name: CartDrawer
components.summary: Commerce-flavor Drawer pre-composed as the side cart. Renders a CartLineItem list (image + title + variant + qty stepper + price + remove), a totals subgroup (subtotal / discount / shipping / total), and a sticky-footer Checkout CTA. Distinct from MiniCart (small popover preview) — CartDrawer is a full side panel.

components.name: Chart
components.summary: Generic chart wrapper that consumes Lumen's CHART_PALETTE and chart-token surface (axes, grid, legend, tooltip). Eleven kinds via the `kind` enum — line / area / bar / stacked-bar / donut / pie / scatter / heatmap / sparkline / funnel / waterfall. Renders via the consumer's adapter (Recharts, Visx, ECharts) but the styling, axis layout, legend, and tooltip skin come from Lumen.

components.name: ChatBubble
components.summary: Chat message row. Renders an avatar (optional), an author name + timestamp meta, the message body, and a reaction bar slot. Three speaker variants — you (right-aligned, accent-tinted), them (left-aligned, raised), ai (left-aligned, AI-shimmer leading). Streaming AI messages render with a typing indicator until complete.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Independent boolean. Square 16 px (md). Unchecked = hairline ring on input bg; checked = lime fill + dark check glyph. Built on Radix Checkbox; uses .lumen-checkbox shell.

components.name: CitationCard
components.summary: Source reference rendered next to an AI-generated value. Composes a small index ('Source 1'), source name, optional excerpt, optional confidence ring. Pairs with AISuggestion / AISummary outputs and with inline citations in prose. Distinct from a plain Link — CitationCard carries the AI provenance visual.

components.name: CoachMark
components.summary: Onboarding tooltip with a backdrop spotlight (dark scrim with a cut-out around the anchor element). Sequenced via a CoachMarkTour wrapper that walks through 3-6 steps with 'Skip' / 'Next' / 'Done'. Distinct from Tooltip (hover, single, transient) and Popover (click, richer content).

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Mono-typeface code display with optional language label, line numbers, copy button, and token highlight. For inline single-token code, use `<code>` or the Kbd primitive. CodeBlock is the multi-line variant. Renders pre-formatted whitespace, wraps on long lines via wrap='wrap' or 'soft', and exposes copy via CopyButton.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.summary: Color selection control. Two variants — swatches (a fixed palette of brand-safe color stops, the operator default) and full (saturation/lightness pad + hue slider + hex input + eyedropper). Always paired with a hex / rgba text input so users with vision differences can type the value.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: Searchable single-choice dropdown. Field-shell trigger + portaled listbox filtered by the typed query. Use when Select's static list would exceed ~12 options. v0.12.4 — listbox renders via createPortal(<div fixed>, document.body) with getBoundingClientRect tracking on scroll (capture phase) + resize, escaping every ancestor's overflow context (Showcase frames, <Card padding='none'>, glass surfaces, scroll containers).

components.name: CommandPaletteButton
components.summary: Search-styled trigger that opens the global command palette. Carries leading search icon, placeholder hint, and trailing keyboard-shortcut chip.

components.name: CommentThread
components.summary: Threaded discussion attached to an entity (a row, an annotation marker, a document range). Renders a list of Comments (avatar + author + time + body + reactions + inline editor on hover-actions), nested Replies one-level-deep, an inline ChatComposer at the bottom, and an optional 'Resolve' affordance.

components.name: Conversation
components.summary: Root container for an AI chat thread. Manages scroll behavior, virtualization for long threads (TanStack Virtual at >100 messages), auto-scroll-to-bottom on new messages, and an empty state. Wraps every Message in the family. Mirrors Vercel AI Elements `Conversation` verbatim.

components.name: CopyButton
components.summary: Compact icon-button that writes a value to the clipboard and flashes a confirmation. Three forms: ghost (the default — minimal, paired with CodeBlock / token / API key surfaces), pill (label + icon, the standalone form), and inline (a leading-icon row that the consumer wraps around a value chip). Announces success via aria-live='polite'.

components.name: DataGrid
components.summary: Power-user tabular surface built on Table. Adds column visibility toggle, column reorder, column resize, frozen / sticky columns, row selection (single / multi), row expansion, inline cell edit, density control, sort indicators on headers, filter chip row, grouped / aggregated / subtotal rows, and pivot. Sparingly use — most operator tables stay on the simpler Table primitive.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Read-only field-shell trigger with leading calendar glyph; click opens a portaled calendar popover. v0.7 ships the visual contract; consumers compose react-day-picker for real selection logic.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal interrupt for confirmation, focused decision, or short-form input.

components.name: Divider
components.summary: Hairline rule that separates content. Horizontal (most common) or vertical (toolbar separator). Optional inline label for section breaks ('OR'). Decorative by default (role='presentation'); use role='separator' when the divider has semantic meaning (between menu groups, between toolbar groups).

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Side-anchored panel that slides over the page. Use for long-form detail views, multi-step forms, and side editors — the affordance is 'I'm peeking at something tied to this page'. Distinct from Dialog (modal interrupt) and Sheet (bottom-anchored mobile primitive).

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.summary: Reveal a portaled menu of actions or routes from a trigger. Single-select per item — items invoke actions immediately on activation. Supports nested sub-menus, dividers, label rows, danger items, keyboard shortcuts, checkboxes, and radio groups. Three triggers it covers: a button menu (kebab/overflow), a route menu (account, workspace switcher), and a right-click ContextMenu (variant via `trigger='context'`).

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Type-led message for empty collections. Headline + supporting line + optional primary action.

components.name: FAB
components.summary: Floating Action Button — round, fixed-position primary action. Single-tap access to the most common verb in a flow.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Composition wrapper for a single form control. Stacks label + description + control shell + hint/error in one vertical group. The control shell owns the focus surface; slots (leading icon, trailing icon, addon) bond under that single ring.

components.name: FileDropzone
components.summary: Drag-and-drop file input. Large dashed-bordered tap target wrapping a hidden native <input type='file'>. Distinct rest, hover, and drag-over states; supports single and multi-file selection.

components.name: Form
components.summary: Semantic form wrapper with dual-mode validation. Native mode (v0.6) is the default — manual `validate` callback, blur-validation, focus-on-first-error. RHF mode (v0.7) activates when a Zod `schema` prop is passed — wraps children in a FormProvider, auto-registers nested Fields by `name`, and surfaces field-level errors automatically.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A square Button containing only an icon. Required aria-label gives the control a name for screen readers and keyboard users.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Single-line text input. The base of every text-entry form control. Renders inside a Field shell that owns the focus surface.

components.name: InventoryStatus
components.summary: Stock state chip for ecommerce / fulfillment surfaces. Five tones — in-stock, low-stock, backorder, preorder, sold-out. Each pairs a glyph + a label + the tone tint. Distinct from Badge (status pill, generic) — InventoryStatus encodes the standard commerce vocabulary so the Lumen library renders the same five tones across Shopify / BigCommerce / Woo surfaces.

components.name: Kanban
components.summary: Horizontal board of vertically-stacked KanbanColumns containing KanbanCards. Drag-and-drop reorders within a column or between columns; keyboard ArrowKeys + space cycles cards through columns per WCAG 2.5.7. Distinct from List (single column) and DataGrid (tabular). The board scrolls horizontally; each column scrolls vertically inside.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: Inline keyboard-key cue. A small monospace pill rendered for shortcuts inside Tooltips, DropdownMenu items, help overlays, and onboarding text. Renders mac-or-platform-aware glyphs (⌘ vs Ctrl) when platform='auto'. Use Kbd, not Tag, for keyboard hints — the visual chrome is distinct.

components.name: KpiCard
components.summary: A single-metric card. Composes: eyebrow label (KPI name) → headline value (large numeric, tabular-nums) → Trend delta → optional Sparkline → optional context line. The denominator of a dashboard. Distinct from Stat (smaller inline value with no trend) and from Chart (multi-series).

components.name: Link
components.summary: Inline text link. Always rendered as an <a>, never a Button — links navigate, buttons act. Three appearances — default (text.primary with underline-on-hover, the prose default), subtle (text.secondary, navigation flavor), and accent (text.accent, sparingly — emphasis on a single CTA inside prose). External links signal with a trailing arrow / ExternalLink glyph and rel='noreferrer noopener'.

components.name: List
components.summary: Vertical sequence primitive — semantic <ul>/<ol> with Lumen chrome. Three flavors: plain (text bullets / numbered), structured (each row is a ListItem with leading/trailing slots, the Apple Settings / iOS-style listview), and interactive (each row navigates or actions, with hover + focus chrome). Pairs with Divider for inset separators; with Skeleton[shape='row'] for loading state.

components.name: LiveDot
components.summary: An 8px green dot with a 2px pulsing ring. Warp signature primitive that signals 'this is live'.

components.name: LogoCloud
components.summary: Social-proof strip of partner / customer logos. Renders 5-12 logos in a 1-row marquee or static grid. Logos render in monochrome (text.tertiary tint) by default — restoring full color on hover/focus is opt-in. Includes a sr-only label naming the partner list.

components.name: Message
components.summary: Single-turn bubble in an AI conversation. Renders user / assistant / system / tool roles with role-appropriate alignment, surface treatment, and accessibility hooks. Mirrors Vercel AI Elements `Message` verbatim; `MessageContent` is the body slot.

components.name: ModeScope
components.summary: Sets data-mode='restrained' | 'expressive' on a container so descendants resolve mode-aware semantic tokens. The single source-of-truth for switching Lumen modes. Components are mode-agnostic; semantic surface / atmosphere / motion tokens rebind under the scope.

components.name: Navbar
components.summary: Top app bar — the single highest-level navigation chrome. Hosts brand mark, primary destinations (or a 'More' overflow), global search trigger, NotificationCenter trigger, account menu. Three variants: marketing (translucent + scroll-aware reveal), operator (compact 48 px chrome), mobile (40 px + hamburger drawer). Always one Navbar per page.

components.name: NotificationCenter
components.summary: Inbox of system + user notifications. Popover-anchored from a Bell icon in the Navbar (default) or a route at /inbox. Items group by recency (Today / Earlier / Last week). Unread items carry a leading dot in text.accent. Hosts read/unread toggle, mark-all-read, archive, and category filter chips. Distinct from Toast (transient) and Alert (in-flow).

components.name: NumberInput
components.summary: Stepper-flanked numeric input. Minus button + mono numeric value + plus button (and optional unit suffix) bonded inside a single field shell.

components.name: OtpInput
components.summary: One-time passcode entry. Row of single-digit cells with auto-advance, backspace-erases-previous, and paste-distribute. Each cell is its own field micro-shell.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Move between fixed-size pages of a list, table, or feed. Two layouts — numeric (Prev / 1 / 2 / 3 / Next, with ellipsis-collapse past 7 pages) and cursor (Prev / Page N of M / Next). The numeric layout maps to keyboard / desktop-density operator tables; the cursor layout maps to mobile and infinite-feed-but-with-page-anchors.

components.name: Panel
components.summary: In-flow collapsible content container. A semantic <section> with a labeled header (h2/h3) and a body, optionally collapsible via a chevron in the header. Three variants — plain (in-page section), bordered (Card-flavored section), and inspector (a docked right-rail panel that can resize). The de-facto 'settings group' / 'inspector panel' primitive.

components.name: PasswordInput
components.summary: Password entry with Show / Hide toggle in the trailing slot. Reuses the field shell; value renders mono with wider tracking so masking dots read as discrete.

components.name: PermissionPrompt
components.summary: Pre-prompt that explains WHY the app needs a system permission BEFORE triggering the OS-native dialog. Renders a centered card with an icon, title (the consequence), description (the value), and two buttons — 'Not now' (secondary) + 'Continue' (primary, which then fires the native prompt). Reduces the deny-rate of platform permission requests by 2-3x. Covers camera, microphone, location, notifications, contacts, photos, motion, tracking transparency, biometric.

components.name: PhoneFrame
components.summary: Decorative chrome that mocks a phone shell for marketing / showcase / docs. Renders the device silhouette (notch, Dynamic Island, home indicator, status bar slot) and clips its child to the screen bounds. Three platforms — ios-notch, ios-island (Dynamic Island), android-pin-hole. Distinct from the iOS / Android platform docs — PhoneFrame is presentation, not runtime.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: Floating panel anchored to a trigger. Hosts richer content than Tooltip — a form, a mini-detail card, a filter group, a date pad. Three open behaviors — click (default), hover-with-intent (rare; mostly preview cards), and manual (controlled). Portaled per AGENTS.md hard rule 10. Distinct from Dialog (modal interrupt) and Tooltip (text-only hover hint).

components.name: PresenceIndicator
components.summary: Live state for one or more users on a surface. Three forms — dot (small ring-bordered colored circle at the corner of an Avatar), inline (chip with text label + dot), avatar-group (live AvatarGroup with presence dots on each + 'editing N seconds ago'). Distinct from Avatar's presence prop — PresenceIndicator can stand alone in a Toolbar or above a Drawer.

components.name: PricingCard
components.summary: Single tier on a pricing page. Composes a plan name, price (with billing cadence + sub-line), feature list with check / cross glyphs, and a CTA. Includes 'highlight' variant for the recommended tier with the v0.12.5 peak-end lift (accent glow + lifted shadow). One highlighted tier per pricing surface (per Premium Psychology principle 3).

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Two shapes — linear (default; 4 px tall stroke with optional label / value cluster) and circular (a ring; ideal for upload completion or small inline indicators). Renders determinate when value is provided, indeterminate when value is undefined. The brand stroke uses color.accent.500 — primary action and progress share the same hue because both represent forward motion. Distinct from Spinner (no value, ≤ 5 s).

components.name: PullToRefresh
components.summary: Mobile-only refresh-on-pull gesture wrapper. Detects a downward drag at the top of a scroll container, expands a Spinner-bearing reveal area, and fires onRefresh when the user pulls past the threshold. Auto-collapses when the consumer resolves the refresh. Distinct from button-driven refresh (use a Refresh IconButton in the Toolbar).

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: Mutually exclusive single choice from 2+ options. Round 16 px ring per option (md). Built on Radix RadioGroup; uses .lumen-radio shell.

components.name: RangeSlider
components.summary: Single-handle or dual-handle bar slider. Sunken track + lime active range + white-with-hairline-border handles. Built on native <input type='range'>.

components.name: RateTicker
components.summary: Horizontal marquee of freight lane rates. Warp signature primitive.

components.name: ReactionBar
components.summary: Emoji reaction row attached to a Comment / ChatBubble / annotation marker. Each reaction is a small chip showing the emoji + tabular count + toggle state. An 'Add reaction' button opens a Popover picker. The user's reaction toggles via tap / Enter.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: Specialized Input variant for search. Leading Search icon, trailing Clear button (visible when value is non-empty), submit-on-Enter, optional suggestions popover. Two flavors — inline (small chrome, sits in a toolbar) and prominent (large chrome, sits at the top of a search page).

components.name: Segmented
components.summary: 2–4 mutually exclusive options on one row. The 'tabs but for a control' pattern. Active segment lifts above the sunken bar with surface.raised + shadow.xs.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Single-choice dropdown from a known list of options. Built on Radix Select for keyboard nav, type-ahead, popover positioning, and screen-reader semantics.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: Mobile-flavor bottom-anchored modal with optional detents (half / large / full). The Apple HIG / iOS 'sheet'. Distinct from Drawer (side, desktop-flavor), Dialog (centered, decision), Popover (anchored, small). On desktop, prefer Drawer side='right'; Sheet is reserved for mobile and tablet portrait.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: Vertical primary navigation rail. Used on operator dashboards and admin consoles where destinations exceed what fits in a Navbar. Two density modes — expanded (label + icon, 240 px) and rail (icon-only, 56 px with Tooltips). Collapsible with a chevron. Includes brand mark, item groups, label sections, footer (account + version).

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Layout-preserving placeholder painted while content loads. Renders the shape of the eventual content — text lines, avatars, cards, table rows — using a faint shimmer that pauses under prefers-reduced-motion. Use for first-paint loads; never combine with a Spinner on the same surface (one signal at a time).

components.name: Slider
components.summary: Single-value range control. One thumb sliding along a track. Distinct from RangeSlider (two thumbs / min+max). Used for volume, opacity, threshold sliders, audio scrubber. Thumb position rendered via inline style.left per AGENTS.md hard rule 12.

components.name: Snackbar
components.summary: Transient, viewport-anchored message with a single trailing action. Mobile-flavor of Toast — wider, bottom-anchored, action-trailing. Use specifically when the user just performed an action and may need to undo or continue. Auto-dismisses after 5 s by default. One Snackbar at a time per viewport. Distinct from Toast (top-right stack, multiple), Alert (region, persistent), and Banner (page-level state).

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: Inline micro-chart for a single time series. 24-48 px tall, no axes, no grid, optional last-point dot. Designed to sit next to a Stat or KpiCard ('this is the trend'). Always paired with a numeric value AND a label — sparklines without context are noise.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Pure CSS rotating-arc loading indicator. Determinate state lives in Progress. Use Spinner ONLY for indeterminate, ≤ 5 s loads — past 5 s upgrade to Progress with a label that names what you're waiting on. Three tones (default, accent, on-action) and four sizes. Inline (icon-button leading) and standalone.

components.name: SplitButton
components.summary: Primary action + dropdown caret in a single joined affordance. Used for actions with a default and 1–4 close-cousin alternates.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: A big bold number with a small uppercase tracked unit and optional delta + sparkline. Warp signature primitive. v0.10 — Satoshi-only; tabular alignment via OpenType tnum, not a separate mono face. v0.11.17 — sparkline is fluid (preferred max width, scales to fit tight columns) and right-anchored via ml-auto; StatGrid `divided` divider is a gap-centred pseudo-element so all columns share equal content area.

components.name: StatusBar
components.summary: Decorative mobile-platform status-bar row. Renders time on the left, carrier / signal / wifi / battery cluster on the right, sized and styled for the iOS island, iOS notch, or Android pin-hole platform. Companion to PhoneFrame.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Linear multi-step progress affordance for an ordered flow. Each step exposes one of four states (complete, current, upcoming, error). Horizontal layout for desktop / wizard surfaces; vertical layout for mobile / settings surfaces. Distinct from Tabs (sibling views, free reordering) and Progress (single continuous value).

components.name: SwipeAction
components.summary: Mobile-only row wrapper that exposes trailing (and optionally leading) actions on horizontal swipe. iOS-flavor — swipe left reveals Delete (red), Archive (neutral), or custom actions; rubberband resistance past the action width. Distinct from desktop right-click context menus (use DropdownMenu trigger='context').

components.name: Switch
components.summary: Binary toggle for an immediate-effect setting. Pill track + sliding thumb. Distinct from Toggle (button-style on/off) and Checkbox (form-submission boolean). Built on Radix Switch.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Operator-density data table. Hairline row dividers, no column dividers, sticky header, tabular numerics.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switch between sibling views inside the same destination. Three chrome variants — pill (sunken track + raised thumb, Apple-flavor), underline (linear sub-nav, Linear-flavor), enclosed (bordered panel, admin-flavor). Distinct from Segmented (single-choice control inside a form row) and from Navbar tabs (top-level nav). One thumb visible at a time. Tab content lives in `<TabsPanel>` siblings with matching `value`.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Compact, often-closable chip for categorizing or filtering. Distinct from Badge (status / count, sm-only, never closable) and TagsInput (a multi-value form control composed of Tags). Five tones map to a soft tinted bg + matching fg; the operator-default 'subtle' tone is a hairline-bordered pill on canvas. Optional leading icon, optional trailing dismiss.

components.name: TagsInput
components.summary: Wrapping chip-row tag entry. Comma OR Enter commits; Backspace on empty draft removes last chip; shell flexes to multi-line when chips wrap.

components.name: TestimonialCard
components.summary: Customer quote card. Composes a quotation, an author (avatar + name + role + company), and optional rating / metric. Used on landing pages, sales decks, case study previews. Operator-flavor (compact, neutral) and marketing-flavor (large, optional accent left-edge stroke).

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text input. Auto-grows up to a cap; resize handle at bottom-right. Inherits the field shell from Input.

components.name: TimePicker
components.summary: Hours/minutes input + am/pm pill toggle on one row inside a field shell. Two narrow numeric inputs, a non-interactive colon separator, and a two-state segmented pill.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: Chronological sequence of events. Vertical (default) or horizontal. Each item carries a marker (dot, icon, or thumbnail), a timestamp, an actor, an event summary, and optional body. Three densities. Used for audit logs, activity feeds, deployment histories, order tracking.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A short non-blocking message anchored to a viewport corner.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A switch for binary on/off settings. Instant-effect changes only.

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: A grouped row of interactive controls — buttons, toggle buttons, dropdowns, dividers — sharing a single tab stop. Used as page-level command bars (above a Table), as floating contextual editor toolbars (rich text), and as dialog footers (the primary/secondary pair). Roving tabindex inside; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight cycles within the group.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A small, dismissible-on-hover, portaled bubble that names a control or clarifies a value. Strictly informational — no actions inside. Triggers on hover-with-intent (700 ms enter / 100 ms leave) and on keyboard focus. Suppressed on touch (a long-press is not a tooltip — use Popover instead). Portaled per AGENTS.md hard rule 10.

components.name: TreeView
components.summary: Hierarchical node list. File tree, navigation tree, org chart. Each node has a chevron-disclosure, an icon, a label, and an optional badge. Selection is single-row; multi-selection lives in DataGrid. Lazy-loaded subtrees announce 'Loading children…' via aria-live.

components.name: Trend
components.summary: Numeric delta indicator. A small chip showing change vs a baseline: '+12.4%', '−3 units', '+$420'. Auto-derives tone from the sign (positive=accent, negative=danger, zero=neutral) unless the consumer flips polarity (some KPIs are 'lower is better' — e.g. churn, page load time). Used inside KPI cards, Stat blocks, table rows, and AI summaries.

components.name: ValidationMessage
components.summary: Inline or summary validation message. Variants: error, warning, success, info. Pairs with Field (inline error/hint) and Form (top-of-form summary). Pulls icon + color + role from one source.
